observations: Handheld device with a pistol-grip handle and a color touchscreen.

A red trigger button is located on the inner grip of the handle.
The text 'POWER SHARE' is embossed on the bottom of the handle/battery (photo 2).
The device is sitting in a foam-lined box; the box has 'HP TYPE' printed on it (photo 2).
No brand name or model number is legible on the device casing.

risks.proof: A video of the device successfully printing a clear line of text on paper.

risks.risk: Touchscreen may be unresponsive or damaged.
risks.proof: A video showing the user navigating the menu and using the on-screen keyboard.

risks.risk: Battery may be degraded or unable to hold a charge.

proof_requests: A clear photo of the manufacturer's label or plate, usually found on the side or under the battery.
A video of the printer performing a test print on a piece of paper.
A photo of the included accessories (ink cartridge, charger, stylus, etc.).
response.reason: The item is identified as a handheld inkjet printer. It can be priced as a generic unbranded model at its worst-case functional state (not printing, no ink).
